package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumTeacherLessonContentRunes = 200000

type GetTeacherContext struct {
	Lessons    repository.LessonRepository
	LessonI18n repository.LessonI18nRepository
}

// Handle returns only active, current canonical lesson text. The requested
// language is exact when available; otherwise Course's base fields are used.
func (uc GetTeacherContext) Handle(ctx context.Context, lessonID, preferredLanguage string) (domain.LessonTeacherContext, error) {
	lessonID = strings.TrimSpace(lessonID)
	preferredLanguage = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(preferredLanguage))
	if lessonID == "" || len(preferredLanguage) > 35 || uc.Lessons == nil {
		return domain.LessonTeacherContext{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid teacher lesson context request", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	item, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LessonTeacherContext{}, err
	}
	if item.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive || item.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.LessonTeacherContext{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	result := domain.LessonTeacherContext{
		LessonID: item.ID, CourseID: item.CourseID, SectionID: item.SectionID,
		Language: "default", Title: item.Title, Excerpt: item.Excerpt,
		Description: item.Description, Revision: item.UpdatedAt.UTC(),
	}
	if preferredLanguage != "" && uc.LessonI18n != nil {
		translations, err := uc.LessonI18n.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.LessonTeacherContext{}, err
		}
		for _, translation := range translations {
			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(translation.Language), preferredLanguage) {
				result.Language = preferredLanguage
				result.Title = translation.Title
				result.Excerpt = translation.Excerpt
				result.Description = translation.Description
				break
			}
		}
	}
	result.Title = strings.TrimSpace(result.Title)
	result.Excerpt = strings.TrimSpace(result.Excerpt)
	result.Description = strings.TrimSpace(result.Description)
	if result.Title == "" || result.Description == "" || !utf8.ValidString(result.Title) ||
		!utf8.ValidString(result.Excerpt) || !utf8.ValidString(result.Description) ||
		utf8.RuneCountInString(result.Title) > 1000 ||
		utf8.RuneCountInString(result.Excerpt) > maximumTeacherLessonContentRunes ||
		utf8.RuneCountInString(result.Description) > maximumTeacherLessonContentRunes {
		return domain.LessonTeacherContext{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: lesson content is outside teacher context bounds", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return result, nil
}
